turns.user: Design me a strong, printable mortar.
turns.text:
I’ll check the available design inputs so we can define strength and printing requirements before running the search.
What compressive strength and test age should I target, which binders and admixtures are available, and what nozzle size, layer height, total print height, and printing speed or layer cycle time will you use?

These inputs define the search space and let me assess buildability for your print job; the final mix will need experimental verification.
